sections.title: 去学校
sections.translation: One day, Xiaoming carried his backpack to school. He brought a book, a notebook, a pencil, an eraser, crayons, markers, paper, and scissors.

sections.title: 听见声音

paragraph.d: g:Verb phrase + 时: when doing something, here during art class.

sections.translation: During art class, Xiaoming heard a voice inside his backpack: ‘Help!’

sections.title: 发现小猫

paragraph.d: g:只 is a measure word for many animals.
g:被 + doer or cause + verb: passive construction.

sections.translation: He opened his backpack and found a kitten tangled in some string!

sections.title: 救出小猫

paragraph.d: g:用 + tool + action: use something to do an action.
g:Adjective + 地 + verb describes how an action is done.
g:把 + object + verb describes what happens to the object.

sections.translation: Xiaoming used scissors to cut the yarn and rescue the kitten. The kitten happily jumped out and accidentally tore Xiaoming’s drawing.

branches.label: 发生什么事？
items: 不小心把小明的画弄破了

sections.title: 重新画画

paragraph.d: g:没有 + verb negates a completed action.
g:用 + tool + action: use something to do an action.
g:再 + verb indicates the next action in a sequence.
g:给 + recipient + action: do something for or to someone or something.

sections.translation: Xiaoming did not get angry. He took out a new sheet of paper, drew a kitten with a pencil, and then colored it with crayons and markers.

sections.title: 帮助别人

paragraph.d: g:不仅……还……: not only… but also…
g:Verb + 得 + description: describes how well something is done.
g:不仅……还……: not only… but also…

sections.translation: The teacher looked at his drawing and said with a smile, ‘Great job! Not only do you draw well, but you are also very kind!’ Xiaoming said happily, ‘Helping others makes me happy!’

背着书包去学校: bēi zhe shū bāo qù xué xiào
高兴地跳出来: gāo xìng de tiào chū lái
不小心把小明的画弄破了: bù xiǎo xīn bǎ Xiǎomíng de huà nòng pò le
用铅笔画了一只小猫: yòng qiān bǐ huà le yì zhī xiǎo māo
Drew a kitten with a pencil
用蜡笔和马克笔: yòng là bǐ hé mǎ kè bǐ
涂上漂亮的颜色: tú shàng piào liang de yán sè
不仅画得好: Not only do you draw well
还很有爱心: But you are also very kind
帮助别人，真快乐！: bāng zhù bié rén, zhēn kuài lè!

sections.en: Xiaoming takes his backpack to school.

sections.cn: 上美术课时，书包里有声音：“救命啊！”
sections.py: Shàng měishù kè shí, shūbāo lǐ yǒu shēngyīn: Jiùmìng a!
sections.en: During art class, a voice calls for help from the backpack.

sections.cn: 小明发现一只小猫被线缠住了！
sections.py: Xiǎomíng fāxiàn yì zhī xiǎomāo bèi xiàn chánzhù le!
sections.en: Xiaoming finds a kitten tangled in string.

sections.cn: 小明救出了小猫，小猫不小心把画弄破了。
sections.py: Xiǎomíng jiùchū le xiǎomāo, xiǎomāo bù xiǎoxīn bǎ huà nòngpò le.
sections.en: Xiaoming rescues the kitten, which accidentally tears his drawing.

sections.cn: 小明没有生气，重新画了一只小猫。
sections.py: Xiǎomíng méiyǒu shēngqì, chóngxīn huà le yì zhī xiǎomāo.
sections.en: Xiaoming is not angry and draws another kitten.

sections.cn: 老师说小明很有爱心。帮助别人，真快乐！
sections.py: Lǎoshī shuō Xiǎomíng hěn yǒu àixīn. Bāngzhù biérén, zhēn kuàilè!
sections.en: The teacher says Xiaoming is kind. Helping others brings joy!
